title: Across the Rockies
placeholder: Placeholder · best Memorial Day or Labor Day
subtitle: Fly into Denver, drive west across Colorado into Utah, fly home from Salt Lake City. Eight new stamps in three days; sightseeing only at each day's last park.

days.title: Fly to Denver
days.html:
✈︎

OAK → DEN after work

Clocks jump an hour forward. Pick up the one-way DEN → SLC rental (Costco Travel).

Sleep near the airport. Tomorrow leaves at 6:55 AM.

Slack option: a hotel near Colorado Springs buys about an hour on Day 1, which helps the Curecanti stamp.
Once dates are set: book OAK → DEN and SLC → OAK, the one-way rental and three hotels. Confirm Curecanti's Saturday hours and Capitol Reef's holiday-Monday hours.

days.title: Florissant, Sand Dunes, Curecanti
days.sub: Denver → Florissant → Great Sand Dunes → Curecanti → Montrose
days.cut: Florissant opens about 9:00 and is closed Mon–Tue, so this has to be Saturday. Curecanti is the tightest: arrive ~3:15, and off-season its visitor center closes at 4:00. Every minute lost in the morning comes off Curecanti.

days.title: Black Canyon, Colorado NM, Arches
days.sub: Montrose → Black Canyon → Colorado NM → Arches → Moab
days.cut: Black Canyon opens at 8:00 and Colorado NM at 9:00, so the morning is relaxed. Check whether Arches needs timed entry on your date.

days.title: Canyonlands, Capitol Reef, home
days.sub: Moab → Island in the Sky → Capitol Reef → Salt Lake City
days.cut: Capitol Reef falls on the holiday Monday; confirm the visitor center is open. Leave Capitol Reef by 4:30 for SLC around 8:05 PM, or by 1:30 for an earlier flight.

stops.via: I-25 S → US-24 W through Colorado Springs and Woodland Park, 118 mi.
stops.name: Florissant Fossil Beds NM
stops.addr: Florissant Fossil Beds National Monument Visitor Center
stops.hrs: Opens about 9:00. Closed Mondays and Tuesdays (staffing). 719-748-3253.
stops.acc: Stamp at the visitor center desk, by the parking lot.
stops.about: Ancient lake beds that preserved insects, leaves and giant petrified redwood stumps from 34 million years ago.

stops.via: US-24 W → US-285 S over Poncha Pass → CO-17 S → Lane 6 E, 166 mi.
stops.name: Great Sand Dunes NP
stops.ok: New park for the 64. The dunes fill the view from the visitor center. Pack lunch: little food between here and Gunnison.
stops.about: The tallest dunes in North America, piled against the Sangre de Cristo Mountains.

stops.via: CO-17 N → Saguache → CO-114 W over North Pass → US-50 W, 148 mi.
stops.name: Curecanti NRA
stops.addr: Elk Creek Visitor Center, Curecanti National Recreation Area
stops.hrs: Summer has run daily from about 8:00. Off-season weekdays only, 9:00–4:00. 970-641-2337.
stops.warn: Tightest stamp of the trip. If you're late, ask whether Black Canyon's South Rim visitor center also has the Curecanti stamp.
stops.about: Three reservoirs on the Gunnison River, including Blue Mesa, Colorado's largest body of water.

stops.name: Blue Mesa overlooks
stops.place: Last stop of the day: sightseeing
stops.note: Pull-offs along US-50 west of Elk Creek, with views from the car or a few steps away.

stops.name: Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP
stops.addr: South Rim Visitor Center, Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
stops.hrs: Opens 8:00 in summer. Winter 9:00–4:00 with a 12:00–12:30 lunch closure. 970-641-2337.
stops.acc: Gunnison Point overlook is a short walk from the visitor center.
stops.about: A canyon so deep and narrow that parts of it get only minutes of sunlight a day.

stops.via: US-50 W → Grand Junction → Rim Rock Drive from the east entrance, 91 mi.
stops.name: Colorado NM
stops.addr: Saddlehorn Visitor Center, Colorado National Monument
stops.about: Red-rock canyons and monoliths along Rim Rock Drive, high above the Grand Valley.

stops.via: Exit at Fruita → I-70 W → US-191 S, 104 mi.
stops.name: Arches NP
stops.hrs: Open daily; closed only on Christmas.
stops.warn: Timed entry wasn't required in summer 2026. Check the rules for your date.
stops.about: More than 2,000 natural stone arches carved from red Entrada sandstone.

stops.name: Arches Scenic Drive
stops.place: Last stop of the day: sightseeing
stops.addr: The Windows Section, Arches National Park
stops.note: Park Avenue viewpoint, Balanced Rock beside the road, then the Windows section, where the arches are visible from the parking area. Finish at the Delicate Arch lower viewpoint.

stops.name: Moab, UT
stops.note: Hotel TBD. Fill the tank tonight: no gas at Island in the Sky. Tomorrow leaves at 7:20.

stops.name: Canyonlands NP
stops.place: Island in the Sky Visitor Center
stops.addr: Island in the Sky Visitor Center
stops.where: Island in the Sky Visitor Center
stops.acc: Shafer Canyon overlook is right next to the visitor center.
stops.about: A mesa standing more than 1,000 feet above the canyons of the Colorado and Green rivers.

stops.via: Back to US-191 → I-70 W → UT-24 via Hanksville, 156 mi.
stops.name: Capitol Reef NP
stops.hrs: Currently 8:00–4:30 daily spring through fall. Confirm holiday-Monday hours: 435-425-3791.
stops.about: Protects the Waterpocket Fold, a nearly 100-mile wrinkle in the Earth's crust, and the pioneer orchards of Fruita.

stops.name: Scenic Drive, petroglyphs, Gifford House
stops.place: Last stop of the day: sightseeing
stops.note: Paved Scenic Drive past the Fruita orchards. The Fremont petroglyph panel on UT-24 has a short boardwalk from its lot. Pie at the Gifford House.

stops.title: Salt Lake City → home
stops.note: Return the car and fly home. For an earlier flight, leave Capitol Reef by 1:30. You land on Pacific time, an hour earlier by the clock.
